scope: Input envelope neutrality and faithful passive node observations; engineering verification, not evidence of consciousness or biological evolution.

full_regression.failure: new upgrade test fixture omitted SET search_path before exercising a trigger; fixture corrected
full_regression.resolution: original failure included in final 30 passing targeted checks

envelope_final.invariant: reference and native Core state hashes and node projections match with altered IDs, labels, carrier grouping and observer settings/on-off

coverage: raw nodes default and accurate history counts
old candidate accessible after later raw samples
initial_issues: older test assumed a candidate remained in first page; now traverses bounded API pages before opening its evidence URL
screenshot review found history count still using derived rows; corrected and browser revalidated

synthetic_observer_cost.scope: synthetic complete-node snapshot, observer+hash+JSON only; excludes Core, database and UI; hardware-specific

limits: Complete means all source nodes at each declared structural sample, not the full edge graph or continuous per-node waveform.
Historical filtered packets are explicitly incomplete; no old data was reconstructed or migrated.
AI receives a declared bounded analysis subset; absent from its input does not imply inactive, irrelevant or unrelated.
Identical-input neutrality does not imply identical physical sensing under different host loads.
Large raw records still have O(nodes times samples) storage and processing cost; no hidden node clipping.
Synthetic observer cost excludes Core, database and UI; concurrent workstation measurement, not a capacity guarantee.
Unregistered multigeneration coordinator work remains separate and is not certified by this record.
